root_cause.text: The `__sctp_rcv_asconf_lookup()` function lacks a bounds check on the address parameter’s declared length before calling `from_addr_param()`, allowing a truncated ASCONF chunk to cause reading of uninitialized memory beyond the chunk.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (sizeof(*asconf) + ntohs(param->p.length) > ntohs(ch->length)) return NULL;` to ensure the entire address parameter lies within the chunk. The CVE description confirms that only the ADDIP header and a parameter header are checked, but the full address is read based on the parameter’s length without verifying it fits, leading to uninitialized reads.
